brief:
Shehab Wire reported that Israeli occupation tools have expanded beyond traditional military infrastructure—tanks, aircraft, checkpoints, and conventional cameras—to include more sophisticated surveillance technology. The shift marks an escalation toward what the agency characterized as a more dangerous phase of control.

The development reflects a broader strategy combining physical territorial control with technological monitoring of populations, encompassing facial recognition systems and data collection capabilities alongside conventional occupation mechanisms.

title: Israel deploys facial recognition and data surveillance alongside military occupation
